name: R096-clefable-metronome-transform-fails-digging
why: Challenge 7. The player's Clefable (389, Metronome 10 PP) calls Metronome 10 times in a row opposite Shuckle (528: Sandstorm, Dig, Flash, Double Team; Attack 10, so it cannot knock Clefable out); every call is a draw of one of the 336 callable moves (1 in 336 each). After the tenth call the script switches to Salamence (753) and plays Aerial Ace (slot 2; it never misses, so a Double Team stack cannot stall the end; luck6). Transform called while Shuckle is underground in its Dig (Clefable is faster, speed 60 against 5, so it acts in the turn after Shuckle's Dig starts): Cmd_transformdataexecution fails against a semi-invulnerable target. Chance per seed about 10/336 x P(Shuckle digging) 0.15 = 0.4%.
